messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High GPU memory OOM rate on streaming-decode cluster eu-west-1; 60% increase in failed streams in last 5m :rotating_light:
alice_oncall: seeing it, joining. grabbing logs now.
ben_runtime: noticing lots of very long token deltas from a handful of API keys — looks like clients generating unbounded tails. header 'max_tokens' sometimes absent.
carol_sre: symptoms: node flaps + container restarts, CUDA OOM stack traces in /var/log/runtime.log, spool queue backlog rising.
dan_custops: flagged customer frank-app reporting ~20% request drops, CS routing P1.
eve_prod: any automated throttle triggered?
ben_runtime: autoshed rules fired but backlog outran soft-shed; kernel fails: "cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory" in decoder loop.
alice_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) enforce server-side hard max token cap 2) throttle per-key token/sec 3) route new streaming requests to fallback small-model pool.
carol_sre: agree. I'll push a temporary kernel arg to limit stream buffer allocation to 2GB on affected nodes.
ben_runtime: pushing a hotfix to API gateway to ignore client max_tokens > 2048 and cap to 512 for streaming endpoints. patch: ```diff
--- opts
+++ opts
@@
- if (req.max_tokens) use(req.max_tokens)
+ cap = min(req.max_tokens || DEFAULT, 512)
+ use(cap)
```
deploy-bot: deploy started: routing-hotfix v2026.3 -> prod-stream-gateway (2 nodes at a time)
dan_custops: I've opened an incident with frank-app, requested request IDs and timestamps for dropped calls. they're seeing partial outputs then cancels.
eve_prod: started draining long-running streams older than 45s for affected api-keys to free KV cache. issuing kill with graceful 5s window.
alice_oncall: also temporarily blacklisting 3 suspicious API keys that show repeated unlimited-length streams. list: key_ak47, key_bison, key_zephyr.
ben_runtime: logs indicate client retry pattern: exponential backoff disabled in SDK v1.2.0 — leads to tight retry loops, compounding token growth. Noting for postmortem.
carol_sre: after kernel arg patch applied to 6 nodes, OOM rate dropped 70% in metrics. still seeing a few stragglers in us-east-2.
dan_custops: frank-app says once we throttled they saw immediate improvement, CS marking as mitigated for them.
alice_oncall: next steps: continue routing to fallback pool until full patch rolls, remediate SDK behavior with devx, and notify customers that server-side caps are now enforced.
eve_prod: rolling full gateway patch now. progress: 4/8 nodes updated.
deploy-bot: deploy success: routing-hotfix v2026.3 -> prod-stream-gateway (completed)
ben_runtime: patch verified: server returns HTTP 422 with body `{\"error\":\"token_limit_exceeded\",\"cap\":512}` when client requests >512 in stream mode.
carol_sre: creating a smoke check to detect any clients still attempting >512 streams; will auto-quarantine keys after 5 infra violations in 1h.
alice_oncall: handing to night oncall @eve_prod in 30m for monitoring + postmortem draft. if anything flares, escalate to runtime team.
dan_custops: customer update prepared: "We identified unbounded generation patterns from third-party SDK causing GPU memory exhaustion; we've enforced a temporary 512 token cap on streaming endpoints and quarantined repeat offenders. We'll follow up with full root cause and remediation steps"
eve_prod: ack, I'll own the postmortem doc and follow up with devx & security for SDK and key blocks.
ben_runtime: note for PMs: Recommend adding server-side default max_tokens and SDK validation to avoid client-side misconfig.
carol_sre: scheduled container restart of 3 warmed nodes to clear potential fragmentation.
alice_oncall: closing incident alert. final status: mitigated -> OOM rate back to baseline, customer impact contained. handoff: @eve_prod (night).
eve_prod: thanks — I'll update incident tracker and runbooks. adding action items: SDK patch, per-key throttles, telemetry for long-tail tokens.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated): duration 00:42:16 — root cause under investigation.
